# json corpus

## Source

Real files of the ecosystems the language reads, copied unchanged: the manifests of five projects (strict json), and the configurations of TypeScript projects and a Deno project (json with comments: `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.app.json`, `deno.jsonc`). `NOTICE` names each file's origin and licence.

## Version

The commit of each source that was its default branch's head on 2026-10-22, in `NOTICE`.
